sentences.en: We had to lessen the impact of the erratic supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不减少不稳定的供应对我们的影响。

sentences.en: That makes me feel good, and also lessens my workload.
sentences.zh: 这让我感觉很好，也减轻了我的工作负担。

sentences.en: Sami agreed to testify against Layla in order to lessen his sentence.
sentences.zh: 萨米同意作证指控莱拉以期减轻自己的刑罚。
